rows.note: Use 決定 as the all-purpose choice for a firm personal or official decision.

example.english: The committee unanimously passed this resolution.
example.traditional: 委員會一致通過呢項決定。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui2 jat1 zi3 tung1 gwo3 ne1 hong6 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use 決心 for strong personal resolve, including the commitment behind a New Year's resolution.

example.english: I made a resolution to quit smoking this year.
example.traditional: 我落定決心，今年一定要戒煙。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lok6 ding6 kyut3 sam1 gam1 nin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaai3 jin1

rows.note: Use 解像度 specifically for the fineness or pixel detail of an image, display, or printout.

example.english: The resolution of the photos taken by this camera is very high.
example.traditional: 呢部相機影出嚟嘅相解像度好高。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 soeng2 gei1 jing2 ceot1 lai4 ge3 soeng2 gaai2 zoeng6 dou6 hou2 gou1
